body_markdown:
🚨


Webinar Alert for


@everyone


🚨


How do you actually measure the ROI of AI features? For most product teams, the answer is still…


it depends.


At @Sprout Social, that wasn’t good enough. This Thursday, join


Blake Kurinsky (


[Blake K.](https://community.mixpanel.com/members/prof_jd61i5OQ7Qxd) ) Director of Product Management at Sprout Social


, as he shares how his team is using Mixpanel to close the gap between AI investment and measurable ROI— cutting time-to-insight from days to minutes and tying product improvements directly to customer value. In this live webinar, you’ll learn how his teams: ➤ Enable non-technical teams to self-serve insights ➤ Turn analysis into real, ROI-driven decisions ➤ Accelerate product iteration with confidence ➤ Measure customer value gains from AI-powered features You’ll see how these workflows can be put into practice, with Customer Success Architect


[Patrick M.](https://community.mixpanel.com/members/prof_b0vsAZvjnxcs) walking through real, impact-driven examples you can apply with your team.


👉
